title: "Bulk RNA-seq analysis"
format: html

## Introduction

Differential expression analysis of bulk RNA-seq data (GEO: GSE301776) from control mice and mice 6 hours, 1 day and 3 days after AEC injection (n = 4 per group). Each time point is compared with Ctrl using DESeq2, followed by over-representation analysis (g:Profiler) and gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA; GO:BP and KEGG).

**Input files** (place in `data/bulk/`, relative to this notebook):

| File               | Content                                                                                                                                         |
|------------------------------------|------------------------------------|
| `gene_count.xls`   | Tab-separated raw read counts; columns `gene_id`, one per sample, `gene_name`, `gene_description`                                               |
| `gene_fpkm.xls`    | Tab-separated FPKM values; columns `gene_id` and one per sample                                                                                 |
| `studydesign2.xls` | Tab-separated sample sheet; columns `Sample` (count column name), `SampleID` (display name), `Treatment` (`Ctrl`, `6_Hours`, `1_Day`, `3_Days`) |

All outputs are written to `results/bulk/`.

## Setup

```{r setup}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DESeq2)
library(apeglm)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(gprofiler2)
library(correlationAnalyzeR)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(enrichplot)
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(ggvenn)
library(plotly)
library(htmlwidgets)

# Paths
data_dir    <- "data/bulk"
results_dir <- "results/bulk"
enrich_dir  <- file.path(results_dir, "enrichment")
dir.create(enrich_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Analysis parameters
groups      <- c("Ctrl", "6_Hours", "1_Day", "3_Days")
reference   <- "Ctrl"
padj_cutoff <- 0.05
lfc_cutoff  <- 1

# Colours
de_colours   <- c(UP = "#1D5B2D", DOWN = "#282973", NO = "grey")
gsea_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("#35113C", "#282973", "#7C98AD", "#D3E5E2"))(99)

set.seed(1)

# MSigDB gene sets for GSEA
GOBP_list <- getTERM2GENE(GSEA_Type = "GO:BP", Species = "mmusculus")
KEGG_list <- getTERM2GENE(GSEA_Type = "KEGG",  Species = "mmusculus")
```

## Load the data

```{r load-data}
meta <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "studydesign2.xls"))
meta$Treatment <- factor(meta$Treatment, levels = groups)

counts_raw <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "gene_count.xls"), row.names = "gene_id")
gene_annot <- counts_raw[, c("gene_name", "gene_description")]
counts     <- as.matrix(counts_raw[, meta$Sample])

fpkm <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "gene_fpkm.xls"), row.names = "gene_id")
fpkm <- fpkm[, meta$Sample]
fpkm <- fpkm[rowSums(fpkm) > 1, ]
log_fpkm <- log2(fpkm + 1)
```

### Variance-stabilised counts

All samples in one DESeq2 object, used for PCA and the heatmap. `blind = FALSE` lets the transformation use the experimental design, as recommended for downstream visualisation in the DESeq2 vignette.

```{r vst}
#| message: false
dds_all <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts, colData = meta, design = ~ Treatment)
dds_all <- dds_all[rowSums(counts(dds_all) >= 10) >= 3, ]
vsd <- vst(dds_all, blind = FALSE)
```

## Quality control

### Expression distribution

```{r boxplot}
pdf(file.path(results_dir, "Boxplot_log2FPKM.pdf"), width = 5, height = 6)
boxplot(log_fpkm, las = 2, main = "log2(FPKM + 1)")
dev.off()
```

### PCA

```{r pca}
# PCA on the 500 most variable genes, as in DESeq2::plotPCA()
pca_df <- plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = "Treatment",  returnData = TRUE)
var_explained <- round(100 * attr(pca_df, "percentVar"), 1)
pca_df$Sample <- meta$SampleID[match(pca_df$name, meta$Sample)]

p_pca <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = Treatment)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Sample), vjust = -1, size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "gray65", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "gray65", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "PCA on variance-stabilised counts (top 500 genes)",
       x = paste0("PC1 (", var_explained[1], "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", var_explained[2], "%)")) +
  theme_classic()

p_pca
ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "PCA.pdf"), p_pca, width = 6, height = 5.6)
```

## Differential expression

### Functions

Each time point is compared with Ctrl in a separate DESeq2 model fitted on those two groups only.

```{r de-functions}
run_deseq <- function(con1, con2 = reference) {
  coldata <- droplevels(meta[meta$Treatment %in% c(con1, con2), ])
  coldata$Treatment <- relevel(coldata$Treatment, ref = con2)

  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts[, coldata$Sample],
                                colData   = coldata,
                                design    = ~ Treatment)
  dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds)) > 1, ]
  dds <- DESeq(dds)

  res <- as.data.frame(results(dds, contrast = c("Treatment", con1, con2)))
  res$gene_name <- gene_annot[rownames(res), "gene_name"]
  res$gene_des  <- gene_annot[rownames(res), "gene_description"]
  res$diffexpressed <- case_when(
    padj <= padj_cutoff & log2FoldChange >  lfc_cutoff ~ "UP",
    padj <= padj_cutoff & log2FoldChange < -lfc_cutoff ~ "DOWN",
    TRUE ~ "NO"
  ) %>% factor(levels = c("NO", "UP", "DOWN"))

  list(dds = dds, res = res)
}

threshold_label <- paste0("padj < ", padj_cutoff, " & |log2FC| > ", lfc_cutoff)

plot_volcano <- function(res, title, xlim = NULL) {
  ggplot(arrange(res, diffexpressed),   # significant genes drawn on top
         aes(log2FoldChange, -log10(padj), colour = diffexpressed, text = gene_name)) +
    geom_point(size = 1.75) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = de_colours) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(padj_cutoff), colour = "gray65", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_cutoff, lfc_cutoff), colour = "gray65", linetype = "dashed") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = xlim) +
    labs(x = "log2 fold change", y = "-log10 padj",
         title = "Volcano plot", subtitle = paste0(title, "   ", threshold_label)) +
    theme_classic()
}

plot_volcano_labelled <- function(res, title, label_genes, xlim = NULL) {
  status <- as.character(res$diffexpressed)
  key_colours <- de_colours[status]
  names(key_colours) <- c(UP = "UP", DOWN = "DOWN", NO = "Not sig.")[status]

  p <- EnhancedVolcano(res,
                       x = "log2FoldChange", y = "padj",
                       lab = res$gene_name, selectLab = label_genes,
                       title = "Volcano plot",
                       subtitle = paste0(title, "   ", threshold_label),
                       caption = NULL,
                       pCutoff = padj_cutoff, FCcutoff = lfc_cutoff,
                       colCustom = key_colours, colAlpha = 0.8, pointSize = 1,
                       ylab = bquote(~ -Log[10] ~ italic(Padj)),
                       drawConnectors = TRUE, widthConnectors = 0.4, colConnectors = "black",
                       boxedLabels = TRUE, labSize = 2) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.title = element_blank())
  if (!is.null(xlim)) p <- p + coord_cartesian(xlim = xlim)
  p
}

run_gsea <- function(dds, con1, con2 = reference) {
  shrunk <- lfcShrink(dds, coef = paste0("Treatment_", con1, "_vs_", con2), type = "apeglm")

  ranks <- setNames(shrunk$log2FoldChange, gene_annot[rownames(shrunk), "gene_name"])
  ranks <- ranks[!is.na(ranks) & !is.na(names(ranks)) & names(ranks) != ""]
  ranks <- ranks[order(abs(ranks), decreasing = TRUE)]
  ranks <- ranks[!duplicated(names(ranks))]   # keep the strongest entry per gene name
  ranks <- sort(ranks, decreasing = TRUE)

  list(
    GOBP = GSEA(ranks, TERM2GENE = GOBP_list, pvalueCutoff = 1, seed = TRUE),
    KEGG = GSEA(ranks, TERM2GENE = KEGG_list, pvalueCutoff = 1, seed = TRUE)
  )
}
```

### Comparisons

Genes to label on the volcano plots, axis limits, and gene sets shown in the GSEA dot plots for each comparison.

```{r comparisons}
comparisons <- list(
  "6_Hours" = list(
    label_genes = c("Gng4", "Gbp2", "Eomes", "Lgr5", "Apold1", "Capn11", "Cxcl10",

    gobp_terms = NULL,
    kegg_terms = NULL

```

### Run all comparisons

```{r run-comparisons}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
DEG_up   <- list()
DEG_down <- list()

for (con1 in names(comparisons)) {
  cfg  <- comparisons[[con1]]
  name <- paste0(con1, "_vs_", reference)
  message("Running ", name)

  de  <- run_deseq(con1)
  res <- de$res
  print(table(res$diffexpressed))
  write.csv(res, file.path(results_dir, paste0(name, "_DESeq2.csv")))

  # Volcano plots
  p_vol <- plot_volcano(res, paste0(con1, " vs ", reference), cfg$xlim)
  ggsave(file.path(results_dir, paste0(name, "_volcano.pdf")), p_vol, width = 4, height = 4)
  saveWidget(ggplotly(p_vol, tooltip = c("text", "x", "y")),
             file.path(results_dir, paste0(name, "_volcano_interactive.html")),
             selfcontained = TRUE)

  p_vol_lab <- plot_volcano_labelled(res, paste0(con1, " vs ", reference),
                                     cfg$label_genes, cfg$xlim)
  ggsave(file.path(results_dir, paste0(name, "_volcano_labelled.pdf")), p_vol_lab,
         width = 4, height = 4)

  # Gene lists for the Venn diagrams
  DEG_up[[name]]   <- na.omit(res$gene_name[res$diffexpressed == "UP"])
  DEG_down[[name]] <- na.omit(res$gene_name[res$diffexpressed == "DOWN"])

  # Over-representation analysis of upregulated genes (g:Profiler)
  go <- gost(DEG_up[[name]], organism = "mmusculus")
  if (!is.null(go)) {
    go$result %>%
      select(term_id, source, term_name, p_value, term_size, query_size,
             intersection_size, precision, recall) %>%
      write.csv(file.path(enrich_dir, paste0(name, "_gprofiler_UP.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  }

  # GSEA on shrunken fold changes
  gsea <- run_gsea(de$dds, con1)
  write.csv(gsea$GOBP@result, file.path(enrich_dir, paste0(name, "_GSEA_GOBP.csv")))
  write.csv(gsea$KEGG@result, file.path(enrich_dir, paste0(name, "_GSEA_KEGG.csv")))

  if (!is.null(cfg$gobp_terms)) {
    p <- dotplot(gsea$GOBP, x = "NES", showCategory = cfg$gobp_terms,
                 title = paste("GSEA GO:BP", con1, "vs", reference)) +
      scale_fill_gradientn(colours = gsea_palette)
    ggsave(file.path(enrich_dir, paste0(name, "_GSEA_GOBP.pdf")), p, width = 6, height = 6)
  }
  if (!is.null(cfg$kegg_terms)) {
    p <- dotplot(gsea$KEGG, showCategory = cfg$kegg_terms,
                 title = paste("GSEA KEGG", con1, "vs", reference)) +
      xlim(0.08, 0.23) +
      scale_fill_gradientn(colours = gsea_palette)
    ggsave(file.path(enrich_dir, paste0(name, "_GSEA_KEGG.pdf")), p, width = 7, height = 6)
  }
}
```

## Overlap between time points

```{r venn}
venn_colours <- c("#282973", "#1D5B2D", "#0E99B2")

p_up <- ggvenn(DEG_up, fill_color = venn_colours, fill_alpha = 0.65,
               set_name_size = 4, stroke_size = 0.5, text_size = 3) +
  ggtitle("Upregulated genes")
p_down <- ggvenn(DEG_down, fill_color = venn_colours, fill_alpha = 0.65,
                 set_name_size = 4, stroke_size = 0.5, text_size = 3) +
  ggtitle("Downregulated genes")

ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "Venn_UP.pdf"),   p_up,   width = 8, height = 5)
ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "Venn_DOWN.pdf"), p_down, width = 8, height = 5)

# Genes in every region of the Venn diagram, one row per gene
venn_table <- function(deg_list) {
  regions <- attr(gplots::venn(deg_list, show.plot = FALSE), "intersections")
  imap_dfr(regions, ~ tibble(region = .y, gene_name = .x))
}
write.csv(venn_table(DEG_up),   file.path(results_dir, "Venn_UP_genes.csv"),   row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(venn_table(DEG_down), file.path(results_dir, "Venn_DOWN_genes.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Selected genes

### Immune genes heatmap (variance-stabilised counts, row z-scores)

```{r heatmap}
vst_mat <- assay(vsd)

immune_genes <- unique(c("Il11", "Il1b", "Tgfb1", "Tnfsf10", "Tnfsf8", "Ccl2", "Ccl6", "Ccl7",
                         "Ccl8", "Ccl9", "Ccl12", "Ccl22", "Cxcl9", "Cxcl10", "Cxcl16", "Ccr1",
                         "Ccr2", "Ccr5", "Ccr7", "Csf2rb", "Csf2rb2", "Lyz2"))

gene_ids <- rownames(gene_annot)[match(immune_genes, gene_annot$gene_name)]
gene_ids <- gene_ids[!is.na(gene_ids) & gene_ids %in% rownames(vst_mat)]

# Order samples by time point so columns and annotation stay aligned
sample_order <- order(meta$Treatment)
mat <- vst_mat[gene_ids, meta$Sample[sample_order]]
rownames(mat) <- gene_annot[gene_ids, "gene_name"]
colnames(mat) <- meta$SampleID[sample_order]
mat_scaled <- t(scale(t(mat)))

ht <- Heatmap(mat_scaled,
              name = "Relative expression",
              cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE,
              top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(Treatment = meta$Treatment[sample_order]),
              column_title = "Regulation of immune system process",
              row_names_side = "left")
draw(ht)

pdf(file.path(results_dir, "Heatmap_immune_genes.pdf"), width = 7, height = 6)
draw(ht)
dev.off()
```
